title: The book is open, and one ask about the speech download
note: The cover opens to its flyleaf, signed "From Mama", and the light comes up. One line, then one quiet card: "Get your words ready", the real size for this phone, a bordered "Download on Wi-Fi" and "Not now". The one filled button is "Write the first one". Nothing downloads until the person taps. The download itself is native and cannot run on web; on a phone this needs a real iPhone check.
text: Back Asha From Mama The book is open. Say one thing about Asha today. That is a letter. Get your words ready Spoken letters are written down on this phone. One download of 575 MB, on Wi-Fi. Download on Wi-Fi Not now Write the first one
